title: 天皇賞（春）の後に・目覚めし好敵手

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright wins the spring Tenno Sho, placing herself firmly among the greatest members of the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Dober, inspired by Mejiro Bright's victory, decides to run in the Takarazuka Kinen, both for herself and for the Mejiro family.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Bright witnesses both Silence Suzuka's rapid improvement and Mejiro Dober's determination, and expresses her wish to race them.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Our next goal might be the autumn Tenno Sho, but we decide to also run in the Takarazuka Kinen as an important litmus test for what's to come.
